upgrades.name: Speakeasy

upgrades.name: Pool Hall

cloister.note: 8 options available; 3 are chosen each run.

upgrades.name: Cloister of Rynna
upgrades.description: Raise your Luck with each Green Room you draft from this Cloister.

upgrades.name: Cloister of Joya
upgrades.description: Permanently add an extra 5 Steps to the main course for each Kitchen, Pantry or Furnace you draft from this Cloister.

upgrades.name: Cloister of Dauja
upgrades.description: Gain 2 Stars for each room with an animal you draft from this Cloister.

upgrades.name: Cloister of Veia
upgrades.description: Find 8 Dig Spots in each room with a fireplace you draft from this Cloister.

upgrades.name: Cloister of Mila
upgrades.description: Find an extra item in each Bedroom you draft from this Cloister.

upgrades.name: Cloister of Lydia
upgrades.description: Add 2 Gold to your Allowance for each Shop you draft from this Cloister.

upgrades.name: Cloister of Orinda
upgrades.description: Open a random door of the Antechamber for each Blackprint you draft from this Cloister.

upgrades.name: Cloister of Draxus
upgrades.description: Gain 4 Ivory Dice for each Dead End room that you WILL draft from this Cloister.

upgrades.name: Hallway Closet
upgrades.description: Provides 2 items + 1 extra item if drafted next to a Hallway.

upgrades.name: Bedroom Closet
upgrades.description: Provides 2 items + 2 extra items if drafted next to a Bedroom.

upgrades.name: Empty Closet
upgrades.description: Provides 0 items + 4 extra items if drafted next to a Red Room.

upgrades.name: Corriyard
upgrades.description: Always left unlocked.
Contains 5 Dig Spots.
+2 Gems.

upgrades.name: Geist Bedroom
upgrades.description: Provides 2 Ivory Dice + 4 additional Ivory Dice if a Tomb has been drafted.

upgrades.name: Guess Bedroom
upgrades.description: Provides a random Bedroom effect. You can also guess what bedroom it is for a bonus reward.

upgrades.name: Quest Bedroom
upgrades.description: Provides 2 additional Gold to the Allowance if the Antechamber is reached in the run.
+1 Key
+1 trunk
An extra Hallway is added to tomorrow's draft pool.
Freight Shipping: a very large package will be delivered here 3 days after drafting this room.
No Contact Delivery: a package will be dropped off on the entrance steps the day after drafting this room.
Same Day Delivery: a package will be delivered here after you reach rank 8.
+2 Keys

upgrades.name: Breakfast Nook
upgrades.description: Provides a Bacon & Eggs dish giving +10 Energy and adds the Morning Room to the day's draft pool.

upgrades.name: Reading Nook
upgrades.description: Provides a guaranteed Library draft from this room.
+8 Steps gained per added Bedroom.

upgrades.name: Nurse's Station
upgrades.description: Sets your Steps to 20 if you enter it with less than 10.

upgrades.name: Indoor Nursery
upgrades.description: 2 Gems appear each time you draft a Green Room. The Nursery itself becomes a Green Room.
1 extra Gem in the prize box.
1 extra Wind-up Key to solve the Puzzle.

upgrades.name: Funeral Parlor
upgrades.description: Gems in the prize box equal the number of Red Rooms in the manor when the box is opened. If the box is empty, decrease Steps by 30.
1 additional Gem
9 additional Gold
1 additional Key

spare-room.note: Two-stage upgrade. The first upgrade irrevocably sets the room color. The second can be changed with another upgrade disk.

upgrades.name: Throne of the Blue Prince
upgrades.description: The next time you draft 8 Blueprints in a row, permanently unlock all blue sealed doors.
